channel.title: Carewell Kits
channel.description: Practical organisers for families caring for an ageing parent.

item.title: 7 things to keep on the fridge for an elderly parent
item.description: A one-page emergency sheet saves precious minutes if paramedics are called: allergies, current medicines, conditions, who to call, GP and hospital, health fund number, and where the advance care directive is kept. A free checklist for family carers.

item.title: How to work out when Mum's tablets will run out
item.description: Simple maths for carers: tablets left ÷ tablets a day = days left. Reorder with about a week to spare, because scripts and pharmacies take time. A spreadsheet can do it daily for every medicine.

item.title: Questions to ask at your elderly parent's GP appointment
item.description: A short list to write down before the appointment: what's new or worse (and since when), falls, medicine side effects or missed doses, scripts to renew, and what to watch for.

item.title: How siblings can share care of an elderly parent without the confusion
item.description: One shared Google Sheet for medicines, refills, appointments and a daily note, so every sibling sees the same picture.

item.title: Family Carer Kit: medication tracker and care organiser (Google Sheets, Excel, printable)
item.description: It tracks every medicine and shows days left and the run-out date, flags reorders and expiring scripts, and includes a doctor visit summary, an emergency fridge page, an appointment log, a daily log and 9 printable pages. Instant download, A$14.

item.title: Why a daily care log helps at the doctor's
item.description: One line a day (mood, sleep, pain, medicines, falls) answers "since when?" at busy appointments.
